message: Forbidden raise in function — handle locally with an explicit result type

evaluator_config.message_template: Forbidden raise in function '{name}' — handle locally with an explicit result type

rationale: A raise is an unhandled failure transferred to an unknown caller. It is a declaration that the function does not know how to handle its own errors. In safety-critical systems, every error must be handled at the point of detection with full contextual awareness. Language dunder methods may still raise when implementing language contracts (e.g. type construction); application logic must not.
remediation: Catch failures within the function and convert them to a structured success/failure result (e.g. Result.failure / Result.success). Do not propagate exceptions for normal error paths.
